meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

варить.gloss: to boil, to cook, to brew

meanings.en: to boil, to cook, to brew

examples.trans: We are cooking soup for lunch.
I can see the toy car.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence

выдумывать.gloss: to invent, to fabricate, to make up

meanings.en: to invent, to make up stories

examples.trans: There is no need to make anything up.
You are making everything up again.

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular
думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.
Why are you hovering over me?

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Where is the restaurant cash register?

examples.text: Он подошёл к кассе оплатить счёт.
examples.trans: He stepped up to the cash desk to pay the bill.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.
I love our town very much.

починить.gloss: to fix, to repair, to mend

meanings.note: Я прекрасно понимаю = I understand perfectly
работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром
used in 'до сих пор' = until now, up to this point

examples.text: Я до сих пор ничего не понял.

meanings.note: Секунду! = One second! / Just a moment!

examples.trans: One second. I'll call right now.
A city is a complex system.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: У этой девочки большой талант к музыке.
examples.trans: This girl has a great talent for music.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
I drank a strong espresso in the morning.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
